acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every HTTP request produces a structured JSON log line with method, path, status_code, latency_ms, user_id, ip, request_id
AC-2: UUID request ID generated per request, stored in context, included in every log line
AC-3: LOG_LEVEL env var controls verbosity; defaults to info; invalid falls back to info with warning
AC-4: GET /api/v1/health - 200+db_ok:true when DB reachable, 503+db_ok:false when not; version field from build
AC-5: Panic recovery middleware - panic logged at error level with request_id, client gets 500 JSON with no stack
AC-6: Docker Compose log driver json-file with max-size:100m max-file:3 for all services
AC-7: Makefile build target uses -ldflags to inject git SHA into main.Version
AC-8: Slow query helper LogSlowQuery logs at warn when query >500ms with sanitized SQL
